_comment: WHAT THIS IS. The stages of the quest. The 'help' command in the terminal shows a CONTEXTUAL list: only the commands of the current stage, not everything at once. A stage is switched by hand (мастер этап <name>) or on its own, when the players reach a particular file.

always.description: how to reach the comms channel

start.title: First room
start.description: Where the party begins and what can be done here.
start.gm_note: Visible to the GM only. What should happen here and when to switch stages.

scripted._comment: A command that does not exist in the system: the answer comes from canned/. This is how story-critical steps are done — steadier for the pace of play.

transition._comment: When the players read this file (cat/less/file/grep…), the stage switches by itself. A command pattern works too: 'on_command'.

finale.title: The way out
finale.description: The last door. It needs a code.
finale.gm_note: The code {{door_code}} is in the note and in the picture. If the conversation with the system went badly, play the exit at the table.
